🪷 Some places ask nothing of you except to slow down. Lumbini is one of them.

This is where Siddhartha Gautama — the Buddha — was born. The Maya Devi Temple marks the exact spot, the ancient Ashoka Pillar stands nearby, and across the monastic zone, Buddhist nations from around the world have built monasteries of their own.

Lumbini is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and it welcomes everyone — pilgrims of every faith, and of none. There are no religious obligations, only gardens and quiet.

🙏 Our 7-day Lumbini & Pokhara journey adds Kathmandu's heritage squares, a Nagarkot sunrise and Pokhara's lakeside — easy driving, private to your family.

If you could sit quietly in one sacred place on earth, which would it be? 👇

Two great Himalayan circuits. One holiday. Which would you walk? 🥾

🅰️ Manaslu Circuit — 16 days around Manaslu (8,163 m), the world's eighth-highest mountain. Remote Tibetan-Buddhist villages, far fewer trekkers, and the Larkya La pass at 5,160 m. Challenging, and wild.

🅱️ Annapurna Circuit — 19 days around the whole Annapurna massif, from lowland rice paddies to the Manang valley and over Thorong La (5,416 m). Better teahouses, more variety, and the Tatopani hot springs on the way down.

Neither needs technical climbing, both have acclimatisation days built in, and both are guided privately for your group — permits, a licensed guide and porters included.

🔱 For Hindus, Buddhists, Jains and followers of Bon, no mountain on earth is more sacred than Kailash — the abode of Lord Shiva.

Our 13-day Mount Kailash Charan Sparsha yatra:
🚐 Kathmandu to Kyirong by road, with a rest day to acclimatise
💧 The turquoise shores of Lake Mansarovar (4,600 m)
🙏 The three-day, roughly 52 km parikrama around the holy peak
⛰️ The Dolma-La Pass at 5,630 m — the most demanding and most revered day

We arrange the Tibet group visa (minimum 5 people) and every permit. Meals are included throughout the tour, with an English-speaking Tibetan guide. From USD 1,750 per person.

This is a high-altitude yatra — please speak to your doctor before you travel.
